jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The Service Excellence team is part of the Common Shared Services (CSS) organization and supports multiple functions including Finance, Supply Chain Management, HR Operations, and Trade, Transport & Logistics. As an AI Engineer within the Business Process Automation team, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on enabling CSS functions to deliver services with greater efficiency and effectiveness. This opportunity covers two complementary tracks within the same team. AI Delivery focuses on industrializing and scaling AI solutions into secure, stable, production-grade services. AI Exploration focuses on evaluating emerging AI capabilities and proving their value through rapid prototypes and pilots. Successful candidates will be aligned to the track and level that best matches their skills and experience, with opportunities to contribute across both areas over time. How You\'ll Make an Impact Design and build AI-powered and agentic solutions that automate complex, repetitive, or decision-driven tasks across Common Shared Services processes. Develop applications leveraging large language models (LLMs) and multimodal foundation models using techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, structured outputs, and context engineering. Build, orchestrate, and govern AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Develop APIs, integrations, and event-driven pipelines that embed AI capabilities into enterprise platforms including SAP, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, data lakehouse environments, and existing automation technologies. Optimize models through prompt engineering, fine-tuning, distillation, and quantization to achieve the right balance of accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost. Establish AI evaluation and observability practices including automated evaluations, regression testing, tracing, quality monitoring, cost governance, and performance measurement. Apply Responsible AI and security-by-design principles, including content safety controls, human oversight, prompt injection protection, privacy safeguards, auditability, and regulatory compliance. Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, and analysts to identify automation opportunities, assess business value, and deliver impactful AI solutions. Translate technical concepts into actionable business insights while maintaining clear documentation, architecture definitions, and knowledge-sharing materials. For AI Delivery, drive the industrialization of validated AI use cases through scalable architectures, LLMOps/MLOps practices, CI/CD automation, deployment standards, and production support models. For AI Exploration, evaluate emerging AI technologies, conduct proofs of concept, benchmark new capabilities, and prototype innovative approaches including GraphRAG, agentic workflows, document intelligence, and multimodal AI solutions. Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Live Hitachi Energy\'s core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your Background Bachelor\'s or Master\'s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage for candidates aligned to the AI Exploration track. 5-10 years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning, or related technical disciplines. Demonstrated experience delivering AI or Generative AI solutions into production environments, or experience building prototypes, conducting applied research, and evaluating emerging AI technologies. Strong programming capabilities in Python, including testing, packaging, asynchronous programming, and software engineering best practices. Experience with SQL is required, while Java or C#/.NET is an advantage. Hands-on experience with LLM and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, CrewAI, and MCP-based integrations. Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search architectures, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, hybrid search, re-ranking techniques, and GraphRAG frameworks. Experience working with cloud AI platforms, particularly Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, along with exposure to platforms such as Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or Databricks Mosaic AI. Strong knowledge of deep learning frameworks including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, ONNX Runtime, and classical machine learning techniques using scikit-learn. Experience with multimodal AI technologies, intelligent document processing, OCR, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and vision-language models. Knowledge of modern software engineering and platform practices including Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, OpenAPI, gRPC, webhooks, and event-driven architectures. Experience with AI evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, MLflow, promptfoo, or Azure AI evaluation services. Solid understanding of data engineering concepts including Databricks, Spark, lakehouse architectures, orchestration frameworks, data quality, and data modelling practices. Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, prompt injection mitigation, security controls, privacy protection, and model governance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, value-driven approach to solving business challenges through AI. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences. A growth mindset with curiosity for emerging AI technologies and the ability to distinguish between technology trends and sustainable business value. Experience working in Agile environments and familiarity with Azure Boards, Jira, or similar project management tools is considered a plus. From design and simulation to real-world deployment, you will make critical technical decisions, with the freedom to experiment, and the responsibility to make it real! If you re excited by the challenge of turning cutting-edge research into precise, repeatable welding systems that can operate in the toughest environments, you re the kind of person we want on our team. At Armatrix, you will design and deploy completely novel and robust robotic welding systems in complex environments, automating tasks that hasn t been automated before. Requirements Bachelor s or Master s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Welding, or Automation Engineering, or relevant experience. Hands-on experience with robotic welding automation, cobot applications, and intelligent manufacturing systems. Experience programming ABB and Fanuc industrial and collaborative robots. Experience with Multipass Welding and Welding parameter optimization. Strong knowledge of Python and C++ for automation, data analysis, and vision-based algorithms. Skilled in 3D modeling, simulation, and design (SolidWorks, robotic cell simulation). Hands-on expertise with computer vision and AI (OpenCV, point cloud processing, defect detection). Program and deploy robotic welding systems on ABB, Fanuc, KUKA, and collaborative robots. Design, plan, and optimize welding paths and custom toolpaths for precision, quality, and repeatability. Integrate vision systems and sensors for real-time seam tracking, weld monitoring, and defect detection. Build end-to-end welding automation solutions, from design and 3D simulation to production deployment. Role Overview Armatrix is looking for engineers who can take the latest advances in robotic welding, automation, and machine vision and turn them into working systems. You should be fluent in welding processes, robot programming, and welding automation, and more importantly, you should have an in-depth understanding of these topics to solve problems that don t come with ready-made solutions. If you re excited by the challenge of turning cutting-edge research into precise, repeatable welding systems that can operate in the toughest environments, you re the kind of person we want on our team. At Armatrix, you will design and deploy completely novel and robust robotic welding systems in complex environments, automating tasks that haven t been automated before. Joining us as a Welding Automation Engineer means you will own core welding automation systems end to end. From design and simulation to real-world deployment, you will make critical technical decisions, with the freedom to experiment, and the responsibility to make it real! jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Job Title- Lead AI Engineer Position type- Full Time Work Location- Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon Working style- Hybrid Shift Time- 12PM to 9PM Required education and certifications critical for the role- BTech in computer science or related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Required years of experience - 10+ years of work experience in relevant field General Description of Role We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to lead a small, high-caliber AI engineering team within our Human Capital Solutions team, embedded within the HCA platform engineering group. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will drive delivery of production-grade AI agents and LLM-powered features that enhance how clients and internal teams interact with Aon s compensation and workforce analytics platform. Working closely with our AI Research and Product Team to adopt established patterns and infrastructure, you will take those patterns and deliver real agentic capability - from natural language interfaces over client data to AI-assisted compensation benchmarking workflows. The ideal candidate pairs strong Python and backend API development skills with genuine hands-on experience building agentic AI systems and has the technical leadership maturity to give direction to experienced engineers, and own delivery end to end. Given how new this space is, we value deep, demonstrable hands-on capability and sound engineering judgement - whether from professional work or significant personal projects - over years in a formal AI title. Responsibilities Own end-to-end delivery for the team: planning, prioritisation, and predictable execution, so the team makes tangible, visible progress. Oversee engineering standards, patterns, and best practices, aligning with the architectural direction set by the AI Research and Product Team. Design and build production-grade AI agents using agentic frameworks (initially LangGraph/LangChain, with other frameworks adopted as the space evolves, including exploration of Claude Agent SDK in sandbox environments), integrating with existing platform APIs to deliver intelligent, context-aware features. Develop and maintain Python-based backend services (such as FastAPI) that expose agent capabilities via REST and server-sent event (SSE) streaming endpoints. Implement secure agent pipelines that correctly propagate user identity and entitlements, ensuring agent behaviour is scoped to individual client subscriptions. Apply a strong understanding of AI-specific security concerns - including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, agent behaviour risks, and reputational exposure - to design agents that are robust and trustworthy in a production enterprise environment. Integrate AI agents with Azure cloud services and internal platform APIs, following established architectural patterns set by the AI Research and Product Team. Instrument agent runs with structured logging, tracing, and observability tooling to support debugging, performance monitoring, and regression prevention. Collaborate closely with the HCA platform team in an agile delivery environment - helping steer and contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and ceremonies. Work alongside the AI Research and Product Team during onboarding and early delivery, absorbing patterns and progressively taking on more independent ownership of agent design decisions. Proactively communicate blockers, unknowns, and design questions - particularly when working at the frontier of rapidly evolving AI tooling. Stay current with the fast-moving AI engineering landscape; evaluate new frameworks, models, and patterns and bring relevant developments back to the team. Skills / Competencies Required 8+ years of overall software development experience, including at least 4 years in Python and backend API development, together with a track record of technical leadership - leading delivery, mentoring engineers, or owning significant systems. Substantial, demonstrable hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-powered systems. Given how new this space is, we value depth of capability over years in a formal AI title. Proven ability to give technical direction to strong, experienced engineers and to run delivery autonomously, making sound decisions independently and knowing when to align with the wider team. Solid understanding of agentic AI concepts and patterns: Tool use, state management, and multi-step reasoning Checkpointing, human-in-the-loop flows, and agent interrupts Multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns Hands-on experience with agentic or LLM frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Claude Agent SDK, or similar); formal professional experience is a plus but demonstrable hands-on capability - including personal projects and sandbox work - is equally valued. Strong Python development skills: Async Python and asyncio patterns Building and consuming REST APIs and SSE streams Python backend frameworks such as FastAPI Experience working with Azure cloud services; familiarity with deploying and operating cloud-hosted AI workloads on Azure. Good understanding of authentication and authorisation patterns (JWT, OAuth2, OIDC) and how to propagate user identity and entitlements securely through an agentic pipeline. Awareness of AI-specific security risks including prompt injection, adversarial inputs, and agent behaviour vulnerabilities - and how to design against them. Experience with observability practices in backend systems: structured logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring; familiarity with AI-specific evaluation and tracing concepts (e.g. MLflow, LangSmith, or similar) is a strong advantage. Experience with containerisation (Docker) for packaging and deploying backend services. Comfortable using AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Cursor) as part of a day-to-day development workflow. Comfortable leading delivery in an agile environment and setting the pace for iterative, dependable execution. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills; proactive in surfacing blockers, unknowns, and design questions across teams and time zones. Genuine curiosity and drive for self-directed learning in a fast-moving technical space. Preferred / Good-to-Have Hands-on experience with LangGraph and/or LangChain in a production or near-production context. Experience with AWS cloud services (ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, S3). Familiarity with PostgreSQL and async database access patterns (psycopg3, SQLAlchemy, or similar). Experience with agent evaluation frameworks and experiment tracking (MLflow, Databricks Agents, or equivalent). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for AI systems - automated testing, evaluation gates, and deployment of model-backed services. Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL - useful when working alongside the existing HCA platform team. Exposure to .NET/C# - helpful for understanding the broader HCA platform codebase these agents integrate with. Prior experience building AI features within enterprise SaaS platforms or data-heavy products. Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty). Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. jobs.title: Associate Consultant | Full Stack Developer - AI
jobs.description: About Us About the Company Viscadia is a leading consulting firm focused on forecasting for life sciences. We help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies make high-stakes decisions with greater clarity and confidence, with teams across the United States, Europe, and India. We are deeply committed to a vision of shared growth and success for our clients, colleagues, and communities. About the Role We are seeking an Associate Consultant to join our India team based in Gurgaon. This role at Viscadia offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of full-stack and cloud software development, system design, artificial intelligence, healthcare analytics, and consulting. You will contribute to the design, development, and enhancement of modern web applications, AI-enabled solutions, and digital platforms used to support pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics. Through hands-on project work and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will deepen your technical expertise, develop an understanding of pharmaceutical business needs, and build a strong foundation for a consulting career. Location Gurgoan, India Why consider Viscadia as your next career step Since our founding in 2010, Viscadia has grown from a startup to a global team that works alongside the companies shaping life sciences. We are dedicated to promoting a positive and supportive work environment where everyone can thrive. Our culture is collaborative by design, with teams across three regions operating as one. We are looking for people who want to grow with us and are excited to help shape what comes next. Roles and Responsibilities Technical Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, responsive, and user-friendly web applications for internal and client-facing platforms. Build modern frontend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React (Next.js is a plus), HTML, and CSS. Develop backend services and application logic using Node.js with TypeScript (e.g., Express or NestJS) as the primary stack, with Python or other relevant backend frameworks as additional options. Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services, including data retrieval, validation, authentication, error handling, and service-to-service communication. Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases; design data models, write efficient queries, and ensure data integrity and performance. Build and maintain end-to-end application functionality, including reusable UI components, application state management, routing, forms, authentication, and backend integrations. Integrate AI capabilities into web applications using large language model (LLM) APIs and AI services, primarily through JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs (e.g., OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK), to build practical, user-focused features such as streaming responses and tool/function calling. Develop and integrate AI-powered workflows such as conversational interfaces, document/data extraction, summarization, intelligent search, and workflow automation. Work with concepts and tools such as prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to build context-aware AI applications. Evaluate and improve AI application outputs for accuracy, relevance, reliability, and latency; implement appropriate validation, error handling, and human review where required. Follow secure and responsible development practices when working with application data and AI services, including appropriate access controls and protection of sensitive information. Write clean, modular, maintainable, and well-documented code; perform debugging, testing, and performance optimization across frontend, backend, and AI-enabled components. Use Git-based source control, participate in code reviews, and contribute to CI/CD, cloud deployment, and application monitoring processes. Design and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS (or Azure/GCP) using services such as compute (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda), object storage (S3), managed databases, API gateways, and queue/event services. Provision and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation); build containerized (Docker) deployments and automated CI/CD pipelines across development, staging, and production environments. Own system design for scalable, reliable, and secure platforms: define architecture, service boundaries, data flows, caching, and asynchronous/event-driven processing, balancing scalability, availability, latency, and cost; document decisions through architecture diagrams and design documents. Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting), cloud security (IAM, secrets management, network isolation, encryption), and cost optimization for deployed applications and AI workloads. Work closely with product, design, data, and engineering teams; participate in technical design discussions and contribute to application architecture and technology decisions. Stay current with full-stack engineering, AI/LLM frameworks, cloud technologies, and emerging development practices, and identify opportunities to improve products and engineering productivity. Business Responsibilities Support the development and enhancement of forecasting and analytics platforms tailored to the needs of pharmaceutical clients across various therapeutic areas. Build an understanding of pharma forecasting concepts, disease areas, treatment landscapes, and market dynamics to contextualize platform features and user workflows. Translate business and functional requirements into intuitive web experiences and AI-enabled features that help users analyze information, access insights, and make informed decisions. Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure product features and deliverables align with client objectives, timelines, and decision-making needs. Participate in requirement discussions, solutioning, demos, and feedback sessions to continuously improve platform usability and functionality. Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement by documenting technical approaches, reusable patterns, and best practices. Develop the ability to independently own technical workstreams and progressively take responsibility for delivering end-to-end solutions. Skills & Technical Proficiencies Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript across frontend and Node.js backend, with a solid understanding of modern language features, asynchronous programming, and object-oriented/functional programming concepts. Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem, including component-based development, hooks, routing, state management, and responsive UI development. Experience with backend development using Node.js/TypeScript (preferred), Python, or a similar language/framework, including building and consuming REST APIs. Working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and/or NoSQL databases; ability to write queries and work with data models. Understanding of full-stack application architecture, authentication/authorization, API design, application security, error handling, and performance optimization. Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs or cloud-based services into web applications; familiarity with JSON and asynchronous workflows. Practical exposure to generative AI/LLM integration, such as using OpenAI or other LLM APIs from JavaScript/TypeScript applications to build AI-powered features, including streaming responses, structured outputs, and tool/function calling. Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); experience building RAG-based applications is an advantage. Familiarity with AI frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain/LangChain.js, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or the Vercel AI SDK, and with evaluating and improving AI-generated outputs, is preferred. Experience with Git, testing practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as AWS (or Azure/GCP); working knowledge of Docker and application monitoring. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation), including networking, IAM, containers, and serverless services. Solid grasp of system design principles: scalability, high availability, caching, message queues, microservices vs. monolith trade-offs, API and data-model design, and the ability to explain design choices through architecture diagrams. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and AI-integrated workflows. Soft Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Strong ownership and attention to detail, with a focus on delivering high-quality and reliable solutions. Adaptable and proactive, with a willingness to learn new technologies and thrive in a dynamic, fast-growing environment. Genuine interest in consulting and technology, with a focus on delivering tangible business value for clients. Domain Expertise (Good to have) Understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, forecasting concepts, treatment journeys, market dynamics, or key therapeutic areas. Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, commercial analytics, forecasting, or other data-intensive applications. Familiarity with industry-standard pharmaceutical datasets such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, or similar secondary data sources. Qualifications Required Bachelor s degree (B.Tech/B.E.) from a recognized engineering institute, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 2+ years of professional experience in full-stack development, software engineering, or web application development. Hands-on experience developing production-grade web applications using a modern frontend framework (preferably React) and a backend technology such as Node.js/TypeScript (preferred) or Python. Experience integrating APIs and databases; exposure to building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features is strongly preferred. Working knowledge of cloud deployment (preferably AWS), containerization, and system design fundamentals; AWS or equivalent cloud certification is an advantage. Benefits Competitive Compensation & Performance Incentives: We offer a highly competitive compensation package, complemented by performance-based incentives that reward excellence, innovation, and leadership. To support your transition, we also provide relocation assistance and reimbursement for moving closer to our office location. In addition, Gratuity, as applicable, is paid in accordance with The Payment of Gratuity Act, over & above the CTC. Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Our benefits are thoughtfully designed to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being. From health insurance and wellness programs to flexible work arrangements, we prioritize your holistic success and balance. Generous Leave policy: Our leave framework includes, but is not limited to, Sick leave, casual leave, earned leave, bereavement leave, maternity & paternity leave - ensuring you have the flexibility and support you need at different stages of life. Global Exposure & Collaborative Culture: Work in a high-impact, intellectually stimulating environment that values collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning. You will have opportunities to engage with global clients, cross-functional teams, and industry thought leaders across geographies. Career Development & Growth Pathways: At Viscadia, your growth is our priority. We offer structured career development programs, leadership training, and opportunities to expand your expertise through global projects, conferences, and innovation initiatives. Viscadia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, or veteran status. Collaborate with data scientists to productionalize ML models, transitioning from prototype to enterprise-ready solutions. Optimize cloud-based data architectures and ML systems for high performance and cost efficiency (AWS, Azure, GCP). Integrate ML models into existing and new system architectures, designing robust APIs for seamless model consumption. Implement MLOps and LLMOps best practices, including CI/CD for ML models, monitoring, and automated retraining workflows. Continuously assess and improve ML system performance, ensuring high availability and minimal downtime. Stay ahead of AI and cloud trends, collaborating with cloud architects to leverage cutting-edge technologies Qualifications 4+ years of experience in cloud-native ML engineering, deploying and maintaining AI models at scale. Hands-on experience with AI cloud platforms (Azure ML, Google AI Platform, AWS SageMaker) and cloud-native services. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with expertise in cloud-native tools like Kubernetes and Docker. Experience building automated ML pipelines, including data preprocessing, model deployment, and monitoring. Proficiency in Linux environments and cloud infrastructure management. Experience operationalizing GenAI applications or AI assistants is a plus. Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. Location: Bengaluru,Indore,Pune 2-3 Yrs Cloud Infrastructure, Azure Devops, SQL, Intelligence, Processing, Microsoft, Natural language processing, Cloud Infrastructure Management

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary : We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on AI Engineer with 3+ years of proven experience in building and deploying solutions using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). You will work on cutting-edge applications leveraging transformer-based architectures, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and scalable AI deployments. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about AI research and real-world productization of generative AI technologies. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and deploy solutions using LLMs (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Mistral, Claude, PaLM, etc.) for various NLP and content generation tasks. Work on fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. Integrate LLMs into enterprise applications with APIs and orchestrate workflows using Python, LangChain, or similar frameworks. Optimize model performance, latency, and cost for production use. Collaborate with data scientists, MLOps engineers, and product managers to deliver scalable AI features. Conduct experiments, analyze results, and publish internal findings or contribute to whitepapers. Ensure ethical, secure, and responsible use of AI technologies in all implementations. Required Skills & Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience working with Generative AI, LLMs, and NLP technologies. Strong programming skills in Python and experience with libraries like Transformers (Hugging Face), LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc. Proven track record of fine-tuning LLMs, developing embeddings, and working with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate). Experience deploying models on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and using ML pipelines or MLOps tools. Solid understanding of deep learning, NLP architectures, tokenization, and evaluation metrics for generative models. Experience in API development and integration of LLMs into user-facing applications. Preferred Qualifications : Masters or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field. Experience with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic, Cohere, or open-source LLMs (e.g., Mistral, Falcon, LLaMA 3). Understanding of RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) and model alignment techniques. Contributions to open-source AI projects or publications in GenAI/LLM. 5-8 Yrs Tokenization, Computer, Natural language processing, Ml, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Neural networks, Languages

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary Automatan is building a network of AI agents designed to support the next generation of business workflows. Our objective is to help enterprises and high-growth companies integrate AI agents into core functions such as sales, marketing, hiring, operations, compliance, and document analysis, and more. We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent agent systems that power these workflows. This role involves working across the full lifecycle of AI product development - from problem definition and model selection to system architecture, deployment, and continuous optimization. The AI Engineer will collaborate closely with product, sales, and leadership teams to translate real-world business problems into scalable AI solutions. The role requires strong technical depth in machine learning, LLMs, and system design, along with the ability to evaluate performance, ensure reliability, and iterate rapidly based on user feedback. This is a high-impact role for someone who can combine engineering rigor with practical problem-solving to build production-grade AI systems and contribute to Automatans core product and long-term technology vision. Responsibilities 1. AI Systems, Agentic Workflows & LLM Applications Design, develop, and optimize advanced Agentic AI systems and multi-agent architectures for complex business workflows. Manage scalable AI infrastructure across cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure. Build intelligent agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and Google ADK enabling reasoning, task execution, tool usage, and cross-agent coordination. Develop and enhance LLM-powered applications for use cases including document analysis, summarization, classification, workflow automation, hiring, sales, and operations. Apply advanced prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and feedback loops to improve output quality, consistency, and reliability. Research, evaluate, and implement state-of-the-art open-source models such as LLaMA, Qwen, and emerging foundation model architectures Deploy, monitor, maintain, and continuously improve AI/ML systems in production environments. 2. Retrieval, Model Serving & AI Infrastructure Design, build, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for high-accuracy, context-aware AI experiences. Manage end-to-end retrieval pipelines including data ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, vector storage, similarity search, and query optimization. Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, and related retrieval technologies to improve relevance, latency, and scalability. Integrate LLM APIs, external tools, and enterprise systems into AI applications to enable dynamic, tool-augmented workflows. Deploy, serve, and optimize open-source models using frameworks such as vLLM and Text Generation Inference (TGI), ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. 3. Backend Engineering, APIs & Production Systems Develop scalable Python-based backend services, microservices, and RESTful APIs for AI applications and model orchestration. Build robust systems for model serving, workflow execution, and seamless integration with external applications. Ensure modular, reusable, maintainable, and production-grade code architecture across AI platforms. Optimize application performance, fault tolerance, observability, logging, and operational reliability. 4. Scalability & Technical Leadership Implement best practices for CI/CD, model versioning, experimentation, monitoring, and performance tracking. Collaborate closely with product, sales, leadership, and customer-facing teams to translate business requirements into AI solutions. Provide technical leadership on architecture decisions, feasibility assessments, trade-offs, solution design, and long-term AI strategy. Establish engineering best practices, technical standards, and scalable development processes across AI initiatives. Skills and Experience 1 to 3 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, building and deploying production-grade machine learning or LLM-based systems. Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, Agentic AI systems, and multi-agent orchestration. Proficiency in building applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar ecosystems. Experience designing and optimizing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and document intelligence systems. Solid understanding of vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, or similar technologies. Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in building scalable backend systems and APIs. Experience working with model inference frameworks such as vLLM, TGI, or equivalent. Familiarity with deploying and managing open-source LLMs such as LLaMA, Qwen, or similar models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deploying scalable AI systems in production. Strong understanding of system design, performance optimization, latency management, and cost efficiency. Ability to evaluate model performance, debug issues, and improve reliability in real-world applications. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment with high ownership and ambiguity. Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building Agentic AI products or AI copilots in production environments. Familiarity with multi-agent coordination, tool usage frameworks, and autonomous workflows. Hands-on experience with MLOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, and monitoring. Experience working with large-scale unstructured data, document processing, and knowledge systems. Exposure to fine-tuning, embeddings optimization, or custom model training workflows. Prior experience in a startup or high-growth product environment. Ability to contribute to technical architecture decisions and long-term AI strategy. Experience collaborating closely with product, sales, or customer-facing teams to ship AI solutions. Understanding of enterprise use cases across operations, compliance, hiring, or business workflows. What We Offer Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI agent systems at the forefront of enterprise workflow automation. Direct collaboration with founders and leadership on product direction, architecture, and innovation. High ownership over core AI systems, infrastructure, and technical decision-making. Exposure to real-world, high-impact use cases across global customers and industries. Flexible work environment (remote / hybrid) with a focus on outcomes and autonomy. Opportunity to work with modern AI stack including LLMs, RAG systems, and scalable inference infrastructure. Fast growth trajectory with the potential to evolve into technical leadership roles. High-impact environment where your work directly influences product, customers, and company direction. 1-3 Yrs Processing, Artificial Intelligence, Languages, Intelligence, Python, Machine, Process, Python Development
